# cookie-parse-lite

> HTTP cookie parsing and serialization with Set-Cookie attribute support and SameSite validation.

Provides RFC 6265 cookie handling: parse request Cookie headers to Map<string, value>, serialize Set-Cookie responses with attributes (maxAge, expires, domain, path, secure, httpOnly, sameSite), and parseSetCookie for parsing Set-Cookie response headers back to structured objects. Case-insensitive attribute parsing. Enforces SameSite=None requires Secure at serialize time.

## API

```typescript
interface CookieAttributes {
  maxAge?: number
  expires?: Date
  domain?: string
  path?: string
  secure?: boolean
  httpOnly?: boolean
  sameSite?: "Strict" | "Lax" | "None"
}

function parse(cookieHeader: string): Map<string, string>
function serialize(name: string, value: string, attributes?: CookieAttributes): string
function parseSetCookie(header: string): { name, value, attributes }
```

## Install

```bash
npm install cookie-parse-lite
```

## Use

```typescript
import { parse, serialize, parseSetCookie } from "cookie-parse-lite";

const cookies = parse("sessionId=abc123; theme=dark");

const setCookie = serialize("token", "xyz", {
  httpOnly: true,
  secure: true,
  sameSite: "Strict",
});
```

## Limits

- No cookie domain/path matching logic (application responsibility)
- Date parsing via Date constructor (no custom format support)
- SameSite=None+Secure enforcement at serialize time only

Part of the Ferrow open-source toolkit: https://github.com/FerrowAI/ferrow-toolkit — sponsored by https://ferrow.ai
